findings.claim: The Section 5 admission state machine routes the first durable charge write directly to ACTIVE/DISPATCHED and omits the mandatory CHARGED_ACCOUNTING_PENDING and COMPLETION_INDEX_CLOSE_PENDING states, contradicting Section 5.2 step 7 and Section 6.3, which forbid dispatch, dependency use or any further ordinary transition until the guarded-writer usage entry and append receipt, APPLIED completion, index CLOSE, reservation reconciliation and zero-open P3 all validate.
findings.evidence_excerpt: first durable write = charge + attempt allocation + bundle/boundary binding
findings.impact: A coordinator following the authoritative state machine can reach ACTIVE/DISPATCHED and dispatch immediately after the charge write, bypassing the charge-accounting/transition closure gates that run-020 required as dispatch prerequisites, so task effects can proceed on an unclosed charge.
findings.recommended_action: Add CHARGED_ACCOUNTING_PENDING and COMPLETION_INDEX_CLOSE_PENDING to the Section 5 state machine and route COMMITTING through the charge write, writer accounting, APPLIED completion, index CLOSE, reconciliation and zero-open P3 before any ACTIVE/DISPATCHED edge.
